questions.question: What keyboard shortcut pastes text without its original formatting in browsers and many editors?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Shift+V pastes clipboard content as plain text, stripping fonts and styles.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the clipboard history panel in Windows 10 and 11?
questions.explanation: Win+V shows previously copied items when clipboard history is enabled.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens Task View, showing all windows and virtual desktops?
questions.explanation: Win+Tab displays Task View for managing windows across virtual desktops.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut creates a new virtual desktop in Windows?
questions.explanation: Win+Ctrl+D adds a virtual desktop for organizing separate workspaces.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the Run dialog box in Windows?
questions.explanation: Win+R opens Run, where commands like cmd or regedit can be launched.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the Settings app in Windows 10 and 11?
questions.explanation: Win+I opens Windows Settings for system, network, and personalization options.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the browsing history page in most web browsers?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+H displays history; note it opens find-and-replace in word processors instead.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the downloads page in Chrome and Edge?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+J shows downloaded files; in word processors it justifies text instead.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the clear browsing data dialog in most browsers?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Shift+Delete opens the dialog for clearing cache, cookies, and history.

questions.question: Which function key opens the developer tools in most web browsers?
questions.explanation: F12 opens DevTools for inspecting elements, console output, and network traffic.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut moves to the previous tab in a web browser?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycles backward through open tabs, the reverse of Ctrl+Tab.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut jumps directly to the last tab in Chrome and Edge?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+9 selects the rightmost tab, while Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+8 pick tabs by position.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut navigates back to the previous page in a web browser?
questions.explanation: Alt+Left arrow returns to the previous page, matching the browser Back button.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut snaps the active window to the left half of the screen?
questions.explanation: Win+Left arrow docks the window to the left side for split-screen viewing.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the Start menu without using the Windows key?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Esc opens the Start menu, a fallback dating to keyboards without a Windows key.

questions.question: During a presentation, a Windows user must switch the projector to 'Duplicate' or 'Second screen only' instantly. Which shortcut opens the projection menu?
questions.explanation: Win+P opens the Project flyout offering PC screen only, Duplicate, Extend, and Second screen only.

questions.question: A user wants to screenshot only the currently active window to the clipboard rather than the whole screen. Which shortcut does this?
questions.explanation: Alt+Print Screen captures only the focused window; Print Screen alone grabs the entire display.

questions.question: A presenter needs the entire Windows screen — not just browser content — to zoom in. Which shortcut activates Magnifier zoom-in?
questions.explanation: Win+Plus launches the Magnifier and zooms the whole desktop; Win+Esc closes it.

questions.question: The third app pinned to a Windows taskbar must open instantly without the mouse. Which shortcut launches it?
questions.explanation: Win+number launches or switches to the app pinned at that taskbar position; Win+3 opens the third.

questions.question: A cluttered desktop must be cleared while keeping only the active window visible. Which Windows shortcut minimizes every other window?
questions.explanation: Win+Home minimizes all windows except the active one; pressing it again restores them.
